answer: A wildfire-patrol AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via thermal-advection attestation. Agents sign infrared frames and local wind logs showing a passing zephyr deflecting plumes from a hotspot, such as an ember near a walnut grove. Verifiers match parallax across overlapping views and reject duplicates, forcing attackers to deploy distinct drones, sensors, and routes per identity. However, dense smoke obscures infrared optics and causes false rejections.
